reminder.subject: Reminder: booking {{code}} at {{site}}
reminder.preview: Your slot at {{site}} is coming up
reminder.intro: This is a reminder of your slot at {{site}}. Show the booking code at the gate. If the truck cannot make it, cancel or move the booking in the carrier portal.

no_show.subject: Booking {{code}} closed as no-show
no_show.intro: The truck for this booking did not check in at {{site}} by {{deadline}}. The booking is closed as a no-show and the slot is free again.
no_show.next: Book a new slot if the delivery still has to take place.
